FLASHCARD · WEATHER, SEASONS & WHAT WE WEAR · AGES 4–5 YEARS

Rainy Day Flashcard for Preschoolers

A rainy day is a drop-by-drop day — steady rain from grey skies, wet pavements, umbrellas up and boots on.

← Cloudy DayPrevious cardStormy Day →Next card

What this card is for

Puddle weather gets its own card — and a plan.

A quick weather game

Cushion puddles across the floor: hop them all without one welly touching down.

What they take from it

Wet-weather plans: a stuck-inside day still holds games.

Print it like this

Print it before the wet week starts, not during.

Tip of the day

Sock-sliding counts as rain sport. The card referees from the sofa.

Teach it, step by step

Want the full walkthrough? Open the Rainy Day lesson on the Learning Path.
